from fractions import Fraction
from math import gcd, isqrt

def check_case(case):
    bits = case['bits']
    fold = 0
    i = 0
    L = len(bits)
    while i + 1 < L:
        fold ^= (bits[i] & 1) ^ (bits[i + 1] & 1)
        i += 2
    if i < L:
        fold ^= (bits[i] & 1)
    xor_ok = (fold == case['xor_claim'])
    g = gcd(abs(case['m']), abs(case['n']))
    wind_ok = (g == case['gcd_claim'])
    ring_ok = ((case['ring'] >= 3) == case['ring_survives'])
    px = case['px']
    py = case['py']
    pz = case['pz']
    qx = case['qx']
    qy = case['qy']
    qz = case['qz']
    cx = py * qz - pz * qy
    cy = pz * qx - px * qz
    cz = px * qy - py * qx
    parallel = (cx == 0 and cy == 0 and cz == 0)
    par_ok = (parallel == case['parallel_claim'])
    a = case['a']
    b = case['b']
    r2 = a * a + b * b
    s = isqrt(r2)
    hyp_ok = (s * s == r2) and (r2 > 1)
    tail_ok = False
    epi_ok = False
    if r2 > 1:
        t = Fraction(2, r2 + 1)
        kappa = Fraction(2, r2 - 1)
        one = Fraction(1, 1)
        ord3 = Fraction(1, 6) * t * t
        ord3_closed = Fraction(2, 3 * (r2 + 1) * (r2 + 1))
        tail_ok = (kappa == (t / (one - t))) and (ord3 == ord3_closed)
        epi_ok = (kappa * Fraction(r2 - 1, 2) == one)
    gear_ok = (case['p'] != 0) and (case['q'] != 0) and (case['an'] != 0) and (case['ad'] != 0) and (case['qn'] > 0)
    claim_holds = xor_ok and wind_ok and ring_ok and par_ok and hyp_ok and tail_ok and epi_ok and gear_ok
    return bool(claim_holds == case['expect_claim'])
